inference_requirements: Same-accession current original8-K cover URL must bind exact slotCIK; source ledger hash/path must match actual cached cover bytes.
Original cover has exactly one consistent explicit USstate/DC incorporation jurisdiction from DEI facts or actual labeled table column.
Parsed current-original GAAP metric evidence uses only literal DOLLAR_SYMBOL; no inferred numerical values.
No IFRS/FPI mention, conflicting named non-USD or reporting-exception evidence in original release/companions.
Cover acceptance has timezone and original filing date is on/after effective ruledate. Upstream event timing/admission gates still apply.
output_interface: current.currency_resolution.currency/method/literal_metric_currencies/cover_evidence/reasons/rule_sources; same optional field on original_prior. Existing evidence.currency and flags.current_metric_currency remain literal.

rule_sources.facts: Final S-X3-20(a)(2) requires non-foreign-private issuers to present financial statements in USD; exceptional non-USD requests remain possible. The date precedes all2019–23 original documents.
Foreign incorporation is distinct from use of domestic forms. Limited non-USD reporting exceptions concern issuers with little/no US operations and a single foreign functional/reporting currency.

scope: Source-only implementation clarification before model fitting/outcome inspection; no numerical amounts or literal labels changed.
unresolved: Foreign/conflicting/missing incorporation, unavailable cover/hash/accession or original timing evidence, non-dollar/missing metric currency, or detected reporting exception never receive this inference.

A furnished earnings exhibit is not independently proven a filed S-X financial statement. This is a transparent domestic-reporting convention inference and cannot prove absence of undisclosed exceptional relief.
Literal namedUSD evidence is kept as EXPLICIT_ORIGINAL_RELEASE_USD and remains separate from regulatory inference.
Currency resolution does not resolve missingGAAP metrics, accounting/duration comparability, or the EPS/preentry-price share basis.
validation: 11 focused extractor tests pass, including actual RLJ2020Q1 original Maryland cover, wrongCIK rejection, literal-label immutability, foreign incorporation, namedCAD and FPI/missing-cover rejection.
